title: Book One · Chapter 132: The Game after Rain
story:
The sun comes out on Wednesday. By afternoon part of the school yard is dry. Leo finds Ronan at the classroom wall.

“Come and play.”

“I need to fix this corner.”

The corner of the cat picture has come loose. Ronan presses it back, but it falls forward again.

“The cat is trying to leave,” Leo says.

“Hold this.”

Leo holds it. Ronan looks for Miss Wu. She has the right things for the picture. She is talking to another teacher. There is a long list between them.

Ronan waits. Leo shifts from one foot to the other.

“They are starting.”

Outside, boys and girls draw two lines on the ground. The game needs runners. Ronan has wanted to play all week. He looks from the wall to the yard.

“You go,” he says.

Leo lets go of the corner. “You can come too.”

“It will fall.”

“Then put it down.”

Ronan looks at the picture. He has spent a whole Saturday drawing that cat. The picture may stay up for a few more days. He wants the other children to see it.

Leo runs outside. Another boy calls his name. Ronan hears them choose sides. His hand is still holding the picture up. At last Miss Wu turns to him.

“Oh, Ronan. Take it down for now.”

“Can we put it back?”

“After lessons. My hands are full.”

She really does have a stack of books in her hands. Ronan takes the cat down carefully. He lays it on his desk, face up.

Then he runs.

Leo's side already has enough people. Ronan stops near the lines. Mei stands on the other side and points beside her.

“Here.”

He joins her side. Leo starts to speak, but the game begins. Ronan has joined the team playing against Leo. Now he must run. There is no time to talk.

The ground is dry in the middle and soft near the wall. He turns too wide and loses his first run. A smaller girl points to the turn. “Turn here,” she tells him. The next time he keeps close to the line.

Leo comes towards him fast. Ronan changes direction. Leo puts one foot in the soft patch and slows. Ronan gets past him.

“Your shoes are too big,” Ronan calls.

“The ground is too small!”

At the end both boys are laughing. There is mud on Leo's heel and a dark mark on Ronan's knee. Mei's side wins by one run.

They wash their hands at the school tap. Leo tries to wash his shoe too. Water runs into it.

“Now you have a boat,” Ronan says.

Leo lifts his foot and shakes it carefully. Mei gives him an old piece of paper to dry the inside. He keeps his head down. “Thank you,” he says.

Ronan gets his own knee clean. The dark mark is only mud. For a while the three children stand in the warm air and wait for their hands to dry. Then the school bell rings. They go back to lessons. Leo's wet shoe makes a small sound at each step.

After lessons Ronan helps put the cat back. This time Miss Wu fixes all four corners. He does not stay to watch it. Leo is waiting at the door. He has a stone. It looks like a tooth.

They walk home and talk about the stone. “A tooth from a dog?” Leo asks. “Too big,” Ronan says. They try some more animals. It is only a stone. They know that. They keep talking until they reach the green gate. Mr Qiu is there, putting his sign away.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：patch＝一小块区域；choose sides＝分队；direction＝方向。

情节提示：mud＝泥；heel＝脚跟；knee＝膝盖。

理解：1. Ronan 为什么开始时没有参加游戏？2. 他加入不同队伍后发生了什么？
